name: 昭和剧场版动画背景
name_en: late-1970s / early-1980s theatrical anime background painting
art: Hand-painted theatrical anime background from around 1980: poster colour on board, airbrushed gradient skies, deep blue-black shadows, simplified but solid forms, a slightly faded print and fine film grain; nostalgic and dramatic, nothing like modern digital anime.

name: 80年代 City Pop 插画
art: 1980s Japanese city-pop record-sleeve illustration: smooth airbrush gradients, clean flat graphic shapes, crisp hard-edged shadows, a cool pastel palette of pale blue, pink and mint, very tidy and stylish, lots of empty sky.

name: 90年代 OVA 写实赛璐珞
art: Early-1990s OVA anime background: dense, realistic but hand-painted cel-era backgrounds, hard cast shadows, muted greens, browns and grey-blues, grimy textures, heavy atmosphere, slight film grain and colour fade.

name: 前卫拼贴动画（和纸纹样）
name_en: avant-garde Japanese anime collage with washi paper
art: Avant-garde anime art direction in the manner of traditional Japanese crafts: everything built from flat layered planes like a theatre stage, washi paper textures, overlaid traditional patterns (seigaiha waves, asanoha, clouds), thin gold-leaf accents, bold dark outlines, saturated but earthy colours, decorative rather than realistic.

name: 弹性透视前卫电视动画
name_en: experimental TV anime with elastic perspective
art: Experimental TV anime look: bold flat colour fields, thick wobbly hand-drawn outlines, deliberately skewed and elastic perspective, buildings leaning and stretching, almost no shading, a punchy limited palette, playful and strange.

name: 同人孔版印刷（Risograph）
art: Japanese indie zine risograph print: only three spot inks (fluorescent pink, teal and yellow) overprinting to make extra colours, coarse grain and halftone dots, visible misregistration between the colour layers, paper texture; anime linework simplified for print.

name: 70年代少女漫画彩页
art: A 1970s shoujo manga colour page: fine black ink linework, screentone dot patterns in the shadows and sky, stars, sparkles and soft flower-like bokeh in the sky, coloured with only one or two pale washes; romantic, delicate and dreamy.

name: 墨色加一点朱红
name_en: monochrome ink anime illustration with one red accent
art: Monochrome anime illustration in black sumi ink and grey washes only, with a single vermilion red accent; dramatic contrast, dry-brush textures and ink splatter, white paper as light, very graphic.

name: 昭和抒情动画
name_en: Showa-era lyrical anime with coloured pencil and watercolour
art: Gentle Showa-era lyrical anime backgrounds: soft coloured pencil over watercolour, faded pastel tones, gentle halation around lights, slightly blurred VHS-era softness, warm and melancholic.

name: 切绘（剪纸剪影）
art: Japanese kirie cut-paper art: the scene made of layered, intricately cut paper silhouettes in a few colours, backlit so the cut shapes glow at the edges, precise lace-like detail in the cut-outs, flat but deep layers.

name: 极细线条＋平涂淡彩
name_en: ultra-fine-line anime illustration with flat pale colour
art: Contemporary indie anime illustration: very thin, precise, even-weight lines with architectural accuracy, flat pale colour fills with no shading and no gradients, lots of white, a cool quiet palette, calm and clean like a technical drawing come to life.

name: 蜡笔油画棒短片动画
name_en: crayon and oil-pastel indie anime short film
art: Indie anime short film drawn in crayon and oil pastel: waxy textured strokes, colours scratched and layered, uneven childlike shapes but a confident composition, the paper showing through, warm and handmade.
